svg.title: Observational Memory: two agents keep the prompt small
svg.desc: The conversation grows as raw messages in the prompt. In the background, about every 6,000 tokens, the Observer turns the newest messages into dated observations, held ready. When the raw messages pass 30,000 tokens, the prepared observations replace the messages they came from, which leave the prompt, and about 6,000 tokens of recent messages stay. When the observation log passes 40,000 tokens, the Reflector rewrites the whole log into a smaller one. Below, the answer prompt in one run on a benchmark history of about 108,000 tokens: an observation log of 2,652 tokens and 28,703 tokens of recent messages not yet observed, which held the changed fact; the answer used the old value. With the recent messages observed first, the prompt held a log of 3,154 tokens and 132 tokens of messages, and the answer used the new value.
svg.text: Observational Memory: two agents keep the prompt small
Mastra's defaults. The Observer replaces old messages with dated notes; the Reflector rewrites the notes when they grow.
Nothing is searched: the notes sit at the start of the prompt.
